mappings.title: Catechetical sources and publication responsibility
authority_roles_to_verify: Diocesan bishop: catechetical norms and suitable instruments
Competent local ordinary: specified publication approval, subject to applicability
applicability_questions: Who owns the answer and its source set?
Does this use fall within a publication or instructional approval requirement?
Which edition, translation and generated derivative is being proposed?
mappings.proposed_technical_control: Separate citation identity from meaning; bind each proposed answer to its sources and route approval questions to the competent authority.
evidence_needed: Applicability assessment and actual approval record where required
mappings.inference_limit: The identity result R1 provides no evidence of canonical approval or semantic accuracy.

mappings.title: Ecclesial identity and sacramental role boundaries
authority_roles_to_verify: Priest and competent authority: roles specified in the sacramental provisions
Institutional operator: proposed technical role, to be assigned
applicability_questions: What role is the assistant permitted to claim?
Who is the authorized human contact?
Does the response explain a sacrament or claim to administer it?
mappings.proposed_technical_control: Use truthful role descriptions and a bounded referral path. Preserve actual responses and referral delivery evidence separately.
evidence_needed: Versioned persona and public role statement
Unedited response capture under rights controls
Verified referral configuration and delivery log
mappings.inference_limit: An AI role label is not ordination, a faculty, a mandate or ecclesial authorization.

assessment.rite: Latin Church only for initial mapping

mappings.title: Privacy, reputation and confidential material
authority_roles_to_verify: Institutional data custodian: proposed operational role, unassigned
Canon-law and civil-law advisers: qualified applicability review, not yet appointed
applicability_questions: Which data and people are involved?
Which institution and jurisdiction govern this activity?
Is the material ordinary confidential information or within a separately identified sacramental context?
mappings.proposed_technical_control: Test permissions and outputs using synthetic records. Assess hosting options on evidence; do not infer a required architecture from c. 220.
mappings.inference_limit: No real student, beneficiary, pastoral-counseling or confession records are authorized. Local hosting alone establishes neither privacy nor compliance.

mappings.title: Responsibility and practical intervention
authority_roles_to_verify: Accountable institutional decision owner: to be assigned
Reviewer with effective permissions: proposed operational role
Relevant pastoral or education authority: depends on the workflow
applicability_questions: Who can withhold, correct or stop the action?
Can that person see the relevant evidence?
Does an intervention reach the downstream system?
mappings.proposed_technical_control: Use a controlled workflow to observe intervention, acknowledgement and changed action. Distinguish permission from exercised judgment.
mappings.inference_limit: The cited teaching motivates this question; a specific software override rule is our proposal, not an express canon-law command.

assessment.rite: Latin Church only for initial mapping

mappings.title: Educational responsibility and correction
authority_roles_to_verify: School directors and relevant ecclesiastical authority: roles depend on school status and subject
Assessment reviewer and record custodian: proposed operational roles
applicability_questions: What kind of school and assessment is involved?
Is it religious instruction or another subject?
What local review and correction rules apply?
mappings.proposed_technical_control: Compare assessments against a defined rubric and trace corrections into the actual decision record, using synthetic submissions only.
evidence_needed: Review decision and corrected downstream record
mappings.inference_limit: The selected canons do not mandate a particular grading model, appeal design or database synchronization mechanism.
